name: image
why: DECLARED DIVERGENCE. An image part. llama.cpp swaps media for a per-process random nonce marker before the template runs, so emit_image() never executes on the server path and byte equality is not available. The runner normalises the marker on both sides; nothing stronger exists.

normalise.why: get_media_marker() is <__media_NONCE__> with a nonce regenerated per server process (mtmd), and content parts are flattened to it before the template sees them. Our renderer emits what the template's emit_image() would have: <|begin_of_image|><|image|><|end_of_image|>.
